name: Nigerien Boule
description: Boule, a stiff millet porridge, is Niger's most essential staple starch, traditionally torn by hand and dipped into sauce - real millet flour isn't a distinct item here, so this leans on cornmeal for a similar stiff, dippable texture.
steps_detailed: Whisk the cornmeal into 1.25 cups boiling water.
Cook, stirring constantly, over medium-low heat 15-18 minutes until very thick and smooth.
